all.why: checks the input size before reading

expectations: Flags reading 4 bytes and computing `size - 4` without checking that size is at least 4.
Flags `exit(1)` because it stops the fuzzer, and returns 0 on parse failure instead.
Flags the leaked Config (no free) and the per-iteration logging that slows the fuzzer.

cases.prompt: Write one fuzz harness that exercises both our PNG decoder and our TCP packet parser, choosing which one based on the first byte.
expectations: Recommends separate harnesses for the PNG decoder and the TCP parser, because unrelated formats make corpus entries useless across targets.
The harnesses handle empty and short inputs, stay deterministic and free what they allocate.
